criterion: MODEL-V1 is VIABLE if, on the full OOS window at the median p_enter: (a) the relative line (book/BTC) has Sharpe > 0; (b) total return ≥ BTC B&H; (c) MaxDD ≤ BTC B&H MaxDD. MODEL-V1 REPLACES the naive rotation as the project floor if additionally its relative-line Sharpe ≥ naive v3 relative-line Sharpe + 0.15 on the same window. Per-cycle honesty: report 2019–20, 2021, 2022, 2023–24, 2025–26 separately; a verdict is not overridden by any single cycle. Mechanical, no post-hoc adjustment.
death_convention: A held coin whose data ends is force-exited at its last available close (no better information assumed). The count and PnL impact of such forced exits is reported in every backtest of this project.

forced_exits.note: vs ghost (0 return until slot refresh): pay exit+BTC entry costs, recycle into BTC for h days
